description:
§22.12 "Runtime `meta.emit` output is gated" (S458 "your recs on all four", item 3) — a runtime `meta.emit` string carrying a `data-scrml-*` attribute (the compiler-owned namespace) is refused at run time: nothing is written, so no `

` appears in the host. The compile is clean — this is a runtime rule with no code.
rationale: §22.12 rule, Compiler-owned names: "No attribute whose name, as parsed (and lowercased), begins with `data-scrml-`"; on a violation the runtime SHALL "write NOTHING".
